detector.description: Alerts when k8s container restarts counts are reported more than 0 for 80% of time in last 5 min
detector.name: (K8s health) K8s container restart count > 0 for 5 min
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.container.restarts').publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(0), lasting='5m', at_least=0.8), auto_resolve_after='15d').publish('(K8s health) K8s container restart count > 0 for 5 min')

rules.description: The value of k8s.container.restarts is above 0 for 80% of 5m.
rules.detectLabel: (K8s health) K8s container restart count > 0 for 5 min
